name: Minakami Hazuki
source:
She is a priestess of the Minakami family and serves as “Yaorozu no Iwato no Omoriyaku” (guardian of Yaorozu no Iwato).

She has a strong sense of justice, is strong-minded and dignified, but also has a bit of a temper. She is a virgin.

Since her parents died early in life, she cares for her younger sister, Satsuki, She desperately endures Kurouto's embarrassing training in place of Satsuki.

Eventually, she begins to feel pleasure in her body, and she can no longer deny it...

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/shimaimiko/index.html]official site[/url]]
